label: A thing is GOOD_4 in a given perfection exactly when, as having that perfection, it is desirable
paraphrase: A thing is good in a given perfection exactly when, as having that perfection, it is desirable. This is the per-perfection reading of 'the notion of good consists in being desirable'; good and desirable are distinct parameters, so the statement is a premise, not a definition of good.
